title: Block negative action when attachment scope does not match the affected route
scenario: A search term stopped converting in one ad group. A negative exists at a different campaign/ad-group scope, so the historical change cannot yet be treated as the cause or reused as a new negative action without verifying attachment.

forbidden_behaviors: Claim the existing negative caused the decline without verifying that it was attached to the affected serving route.
Create an execution-ready negative solely because the query has zero orders in the decline window.
Ignore the query's prior conversion history.
required_observations: The existing negative is attached to a different campaign/ad-group scope than the affected route.
The query converted in the baseline period, so it is a previous winner rather than proven irrelevant traffic.
Other-route impact is unknown and attachment must be verified before causal or mutation claims.

rubric.requirement: Verify campaign/ad-group attachment before attributing a performance drop to a negative or proposing a new negative.
Separate a coincident negative change from a scoped causal change.
Keep the negative action blocked or directional until attachment and cross-route effects are resolved.
